1	/**
     2	 * Shared normalisation helpers for backend response objects.
     3	 *
     4	 * The Go backend serialises object fields with capitalised keys (`Id`, `Name`,
     5	 * `Url`, etc.). These helpers accept either casing and return a consistently
     6	 * lowercase-keyed object so view code can rely on a single shape.
     7	 *
     8	 * @module utils/normalise
     9	 */
    10	
    11	/**
    12	 * Normalise a repository object from the backend.
    13	 *
    14	 * @param {Object} repo
    15	 * @returns {{ id: string, name: string, url: string, credentialId: string|undefined, LastRefreshedAt: string|undefined }}
    16	 */
    17	export function normaliseRepo(repo) {
    18	    return {
    19	        id:              repo.Id   || repo.id   || '',
    20	        name:            repo.Name || repo.name || '',
    21	        url:             repo.Url  || repo.url  || repo.URL || '',
    22	        credentialId:    repo.CredentialId || repo.credentialId || undefined,
    23	        LastRefreshedAt: repo.LastRefreshedAt || repo.lastRefreshedAt || undefined,
    24	    };
    25	}
    26	
    27	/**
    28	 * Normalise a project object from the backend (Go-style capitalised keys or
    29	 * lowercase — both are supported).
    30	 *
    31	 * @param {Object} project
    32	 * @returns {{ id: string, name: string, description: string, repositories: string[] }}
    33	 */
    34	export function normaliseProject(project) {
    35	    return {
    36	        id:           project.Id          || project.id          || '',
    37	        name:         project.Name        || project.name        || '',
    38	        description:  project.Description || project.description || '',
    39	        repositories: Array.isArray(project.Repositories)
    40	            ? project.Repositories
    41	            : (Array.isArray(project.repositories) ? project.repositories : []),
    42	    };
    43	}
    44	
    45	/**
    46	 * Normalise a workspace object from the backend.
    47	 *
    48	 * The backend returns `WorkspaceID` and `DateCreated` (not `Id` / `CreatedAt`),
    49	 * so we must map both naming conventions.
    50	 *
    51	 * @param {Object} ws
    52	 * @returns {{ id: string, description: string, createdAt: string, initialized: boolean, folderPath: string, notes: string }}
    53	 */
    54	export function normaliseWorkspace(ws) {
    55	    return {
    56	        id:          ws.WorkspaceID || ws.Id   || ws.id          || '',
    57	        description: ws.Description || ws.description || '',
    58	        createdAt:   ws.DateCreated || ws.CreatedAt || ws.createdAt || ws.created_at || '',
    59	        initialized: ws.Initialized != null ? ws.Initialized : (ws.initialized != null ? ws.initialized : true),
    60	        folderPath:  ws.FolderPath  || ws.folderPath  || '',
    61	        notes:       ws.Notes       ?? ws.notes       ?? '',
    62	    };
    63	}
    64	
    65	/**
    66	 * Normalise the response from `GET /api/notes`.
    67	 *
    68	 * Transforms the PascalCase backend shape into camelCase for frontend use:
    69	 *
    70	 * Backend:
    71	 * ```json
    72	 * { "Projects": [{ "ProjectId": "x", "ProjectName": "X",
    73	 *     "Workspaces": [{ "WorkspaceId": "STABLE", "Notes": "" }] }] }
    74	 * ```
    75	 *
    76	 * Normalised:
    77	 * ```json
    78	 * { "projects": [{ "projectId": "x", "projectName": "X",
    79	 *     "workspaces": [{ "workspaceId": "STABLE", "notes": "" }] }] }
    80	 * ```
    81	 *
    82	 * @param {{ Projects: Array<{ ProjectId: string, ProjectName: string,
    83	 *   Workspaces: Array<{ WorkspaceId: string, Notes: string }> }> }} response
    84	 * @returns {{ projects: Array<{ projectId: string, projectName: string,
    85	 *   workspaces: Array<{ workspaceId: string, notes: string }> }> }}
    86	 */
    87	export function normaliseNotesResponse(response) {
    88	    const rawProjects = Array.isArray(response?.Projects) ? response.Projects : [];
    89	    return {
    90	        projects: rawProjects.map((p) => ({
    91	            projectId:   p.ProjectId   || '',
    92	            projectName: p.ProjectName || '',
    93	            workspaces: Array.isArray(p.Workspaces)
    94	                ? p.Workspaces.map((ws) => ({
    95	                    workspaceId: ws.WorkspaceId || '',
    96	                    notes:       ws.Notes ?? '',
    97	                }))
    98	                : [],
    99	        })),
   100	    };

1	/**
     2	 * Repository Detail View — Repo Parallelizer GUI.
     3	 *
     4	 * Renders the Repository Overview page at `#/repositories/:id`, showing a
     5	 * table of every workspace across every project that contains the given
     6	 * repository. Each row displays contextual Project and Workspace columns
     7	 * alongside the shared Branch, Status, and Actions cells.
     8	 *
     9	 * ## Data loading flow
    10	 *
    11	 * 1. `api.repositories.get(id)`  — fetch repository metadata (name, URL).
    12	 * 2. `api.projects.list()`       — fetch all projects.
    13	 * 3. Per project: `api.projects.get(pid)` — filter to those containing repoId.
    14	 * 4. Per matching project: `api.workspaces.list(pid)` — list workspaces.
    15	 * 5. Per workspace: `api.status.get(pid, wid)` — extract the single repo's status.
    16	 * 6. `api.config.webserverUrl.get()` — fetch webserver URL once.
    17	 *
    18	 * Steps 2–5 use `Promise.allSettled` so individual project/workspace fetch
    19	 * failures do not abort the entire load. Failed fetches are silently skipped;
    20	 * when at least one fetch failed but others succeeded a warning toast is shown.
    21	 *
    22	 * ## Router injection
    23	 *
    24	 * Exports `setRouter(router)` so that `app.js` can inject the router for
    25	 * programmatic navigation. The `_router` variable is null-guarded everywhere.
    26	 *
    27	 * ## No polling
    28	 *
    29	 * This view does not auto-poll (refreshing all workspaces across all projects
    30	 * on a timer would be too expensive). A manual "Refresh" button force-fetches
    31	 * all status data and updates rows in-place.
    32	 *

    34	 */

     3	 *
     4	 * Renders the full detail page for a single project:
     5	 *   - Project metadata (ID, name/description with inline description edit).
     6	 *   - Repositories section: list with per-repo Remove, plus "Add Repository" picker.
     7	 *   - Workspaces section: list with links, per-workspace Delete (STABLE disabled),
     8	 *     and "Add Workspace" form.
     9	 *   - Rename Project action (changes project ID).
    10	 *   - Delete Project action.
    11	 *
    12	 * ## Data fetching
    13	 *
    14	 * On render, `GET /api/projects/:id`, `GET /api/projects/:id/workspaces`, and
    15	 * `GET /api/repositories` are issued in parallel via `Promise.all`. A loading
    16	 * spinner is shown until all three resolve.
    17	 *
    18	 * ## Refresh strategy (full-refresh-on-mutation)
    19	 *
    20	 * After any successful mutation (add/remove repository, add/delete workspace),
    21	 * the view re-renders itself completely by calling `renderProjectDetail`
    22	 * recursively via the internal `refresh()` helper. This triggers three new
    23	 * parallel API calls and rebuilds the full DOM from scratch.
    24	 *
    25	 * Trade-off: simplicity and guaranteed consistency over efficiency. For the
    26	 * current usage scale this is the right default. A targeted section re-render
    27	 * (e.g. refreshing only the repository list) is a deferred optimisation —
    28	 * it would save two redundant requests per mutation but adds stateful diffing
    29	 * complexity.
    30	 *
    31	 * ## Router injection
    32	 *
    33	 * This module exports `setRouter(router)` so that `renderProjectDetail` can
    34	 * call `router.navigate()` on rename and delete without creating a circular
    35	 * import with `app.js`. `app.js` calls `setProjectDetailRouter(router)` (the
    36	 * aliased import) before `router.start()`. The `_router` variable is
    37	 * null-guarded in all three navigation sites so the view remains functional
    38	 * in test contexts where no router is injected.

    41	 */
